'''Malagarr''' was located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. Its primary terrain was [[Color/Legends|red]] sand. It was home to [[Droid/Legends|droids]] of [[Q-7N]]'s type. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] made an incursion there.
